A LITTLE CLARITY

Your questions deserve clear sources.

StudentPath is a university RAG project designed to help students find and understand official Irish immigration guidance.

The first version focuses on Stamp 2 registration and renewal, and the transition to graduate Stamp 1G. It does not decide individual eligibility.

This is an interface preview. Live answers require a connected REST gateway. Use connection settings to configure one.
